senses.gloss: नाम(न्)- + कर्मन् नाम(न्)- + कर्मन्, n. the ceremony of giving a name to a child, Rām. 1, 19, 14.
नामजाति- + ग्रह नामजाति- + ग्रह, i. e. नामन्-जाति- [] m. mentioning name and classes, Man. 8, 271.

नम् नम्, i. 1, Par. (also Ātm., MBh. 3, 1200, especially when intransitive),
 1. To bow to (with dat., gen. and acc.), Chr. 287, 8 = Rigv. i. 48, 8 (नानाम, ved. pf. red.); Bhāg. P. 4, 9, 47; MBh. 10, 495; Hariv. 10235.
 2. To bow, Bhartṛ. 3, 61.
 3. To submit, Kām. Nītis. 8, 55.
 4. To sink, Mṛcch. 85, 11.
 5. To bend, Suśr. 1, 254, 7.
 6. † To sound.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. नत,
 1. Inclined to (with acc. and gen.), Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 40.
 2. Cast down, Pañc. 46, 5; Rājat. 5, 372 (read एका नतमुखी).
 3. Bent, curved, Rām. 2, 96, 15; crooked, Vikr. d. 95.
 4. Sunk in (not prominent), Kumāras. 1, 38.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. नमनीय, To [] be bowed to, Bhāg. P. 3, 21, 21.
 --Caus. ना̆मय,
 1. To cause to bow, Ragh. 8, 9.
 2. To curve, bend, Pañc. i. d. 430; (as a bow), MBh. 3, 3039.
 3. To cause to sink in, Hariv. 3754.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. अ-नाम्य, adj. Not to be curved, or bent, Pañc. i. d. 430; MBh. 5, 1335.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To bow to, Indr. 2, 19.
 --With अव अव,
 1. To bow, Bhāg. P. 5, 25, 4.
 2. To stoop, MBh. 1, 5336 (anomal red. pf. ननामिरे). अवनत,
 1. Stooping, MBh. 3, 1776.
 2. Bent, crooked, Rām. 2, 56, 7; Kumāras. 5, 86.
 3. Sunk in (not prominent), Rām. 6, 23, 12.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to bow, Hariv. 3586.
 2. To bend (a bow), MBh. 8, 4606.
 --With अभ्यव अभि-अव, Caus. To bend downward, MBh. 3, 10062.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To bow, Rām. 2, 25, 38.
 2. To bow to (acc.), Bhāg. P. 8, 23, 3. आनत,
 1. Stooping, Hariv. 6344.
 2. Stooping to (with acc.), Bhāg. P. 1, 2, 2.
 3. Submissive, Man. 7, 69.
 4. Bent, MBh. 1, 1667.
 --Caus.
 1. To bend downward, 5561.
 2. To subdue, 4, 967.
 3. To bend (a bow), 1, 7088.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To rise, Pañc. ii. d. 98.
 2. To erect, to raise, Pañc. i. d. 407. उन्नत,
 1. Erected, upright. Hit. 76, 6; raised, Draup. 5, 1.
 2. High, Kir. 5, 15.
 3. Sublime, Pañc. 24, 17.
 4. Prominent, Mṛcch. 144, 18.
 5. Vaulted, Bhartṛ. 1, 41.
 --Caus. To raise Rām. 5, 30, 12.
 --With अभ्युद् अभि-उद्, अभ्युन्नत, Elevated, Śāk. d. 56.
 --With समभ्युद् सम्-अभि-उद्, समभ्युन्नत, Risen, Mṛcch. 76, 20.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, प्रोन्नत,
 1. Very elevated, Pañc. 118, 9.
 2. Superior, i. d. 387.
 --Caus. To erect, Bhāg. P. 8, 21, 3.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, समुन्नत, []
 1. Upright, Hit. 76, 6.
 2. High, Rājat. 5, 38.
 3. Sublime, Kām. Nītis. 1, 64.
 4. Prominent, Rām. 3, 52, 30.
 5. Vaulted, Amar. 51.
 --Caus. To raise, Śāk. 40, 16.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To fall to one's share (with dat. and gen.), Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 14.
 2. To present one with (acc. of the person and instr. of the object), 6, 19, 16. उपनत,
 1. One who has submitted to somebody, MBh. 1, 5623.
 2. Approached, Ragh. 10, 40.
 3. Near, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 18.
 4. Due, 4, 27, 25.
 --With निस् निस् णम् णम्, न्त्र्णत, Prominent, MBh. 7, 7894.
 --With परि परि णम् णम्,
 1. To stoop (as an elephant about to strike with his tusks), Śiś. 18, 27.
 2. To turn aside, Bhartṛ. 1, 4.
 3. To change into (instr.), Kir. 13, 44.
 4. To be digested, Pañc. 232, 7.
 5. To grow old, Kir. 5, 37. परिणत,
 1. Changed into (instr.), Megh. 46.
 2. Ripe, MBh. 5, 1109.
 3. Advanced, Pañc. 197, 18. m. An elephant stooping to strike with his tusks, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 17.
 --Caus.
 1. To ripen, Hariv. 2957.
 2. To pass, MBh. 6, 3847.
 3. To stoop, MBh. 8, 1143.
 --With प्र प्र णम् णम्,
 1. To bow, Man. 2, 197.
 2. To bow to, Man. 8, 23. प्रणत,
 1. Bowing, Man. 11, 195.
 2. Bowing to (with gen. and acc.), MBh. 4, 202; Rām. 1, 52, 1.
 --Caus.
 1. To order to bow to, Kumāras. 7, 27.
 2. To bend, Mālav. d. 47.
 3. To give. respectfully, Amar. 82.
 --With अभिप्र अभि-प्र,
 1. To bow, Rām. 1, 18, 5 Gorr.
 2. To bow to, 2, 100, 37 Gorr. अभिप्रणत, 1, 70, 5 Gorr.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To bow to, Rām. 2, 112, 23.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To bow, MBh. 3, 2929.
 2. To bend, Bhartṛ. 1, 66. विनत,
 1. Sunk down, drooping, Śāk. d. 58; cast down. Brāhmaṇ. 1, 13.
 2. Bent, Rām. 3, 50, 2.
 3. Stooping, Ghaṭ. 18. [] f. ता,
 1. A sort of basket.
 2. The wife of Kaśyapa and mother of Araṇa and Garuḍa.
 --Caus.
 1. To bend down, MBh. 3, 15588.
 2. To bend, 4, 394; (a bow), 1, 5436.
 3. To incline, Amar. 81.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To bow, Rām. 2, 72, 30.
 2. To bow to, MBh. 5, 1130.
 3. To submit to, Ragh. 18, 33. संनत,
 1. Bent, Rām. 3, 16, 5.
 2. Curved, Kumāras. 1, 34.
 3. Stooping, Indr. 1, 10.
 4. Bowed to, Bhāg. P. 7, 4, 32.
 --Caus.
 1. To bend, MBh. 12, 10675.
 2. To cause to sink, Bhāg. P. 8, 18, 20.
 --Cf. νέμω; Goth. and A.S. niman (originally, to subdue); perhaps A.S. ge-nedhan (cf. नत).
नमस् नम् + अस्, n. Bowing, adoration, Bhāg. P. 3, 13, 41; Rām. 1, 52, 17.
नमस्कर्तृ नमस्-कर्तृ, m. One who adores (the gods), MBh. 13, 6706.

नमस्कार नमस्-कार, m. and नमस्क्रिया नमस्-क्रिया, f. Adoration, Nal. 5, 16; MBh. 15, 954.
 --Comp.

नमस्य नमस्य, a denomin. derived from नमस् by य, Par. (Ātm. MBh. 13, 5129). To adore, MBh. 2, 234.
 --With the prep. सम् सम्, The same, Hariv. 7769.
नमस्य नमस् + य, adj., or ptcple. of the fut. pass. of नमस्य, What ought to be adored, MBh. 13, 2142.
नमस्विन् नमस् + विन्, adj. Respectful, Lass. 102, 7 = Rigv. vii. 14, 1.
नमुचि न-मुच् + इ, m. The name of a demon subdued by Indra, MBh. 1, 2530.
† नम्ब् नम्ब्, i. 1, Par. To go, to move.

नम्र नम् + र, adj., f. रा.
 1. Bent, Bhartṛ. 2, 62.
 2. Bowed, Bhāg. P. 6, 17, 16.
 3. Crooked, Ṛt. 6, 10.
 4. Addicted, Kathās. 17, 56.
 --Comp.

नम्रता नम्र + ता, f.
 1. Bowing, Rājat. 5, 223.
 2. Respect, Bhartṛ. 2, 52.
 3. Humbleness, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 15.
नम्रत्व नम्र + त्व, n. Humility, Bhartṛ. 2, 59.
नाम नाम, see नामन्.
नामक नामक, i. e. नामन् + क, a substitute for नामन् at the end of comp. adj., f. मिका, e. g. चन्द्र-सरस्-, Called Candrasaras, Pañc. 159, 20. पर्वत-नामिका, f. Having the name of a mountain, Man. 3, 9.

नामतस् नामतस्, i. e. नामन् + तस्, adv.
 1. = the abl. of नामन्, Bhāg. P. 5, 12, 8.
 2. By name, together with the name, Man. 8, 255.
 3. With respect to the name, Śāk. 104, 22.

नामधेय नामधेय, i. e. नामन् + धेय [] (vb. धा), n.
 1. A name, Man. 2, 123.
 2. A title, Bhāg. P. 4, 22, 56.
 3. The ceremony of giving a name to a child, Man. 2, 30.
 --Comp.
नामधेयतस् नामधेय + तस्, adv. By name, Rām. 4, 62, 10.

नामन् नामन्, i. e. ज्ञा + मन्,
 I. n.
 1. A name, Man. 2, 128.
 2. Only the name (opposed to the reality), 157.
 II. acc. sing. नाम, adv.
 1. By name, Man. 3, 127.
 2. Indeed, of course, 8, 335.
 3. Perhaps, Rām. 2, 85, 18 Gorr.
 4. It is often preceded,
 a. by an interrogative pronoun, Then, Rām. 2, 15, 20 Gorr.;
 b. by अपि, Perhaps, 2, 97, 6 Gorr. Of course, Śāk. 93, 5, v. r.; would that;
 c. by मा, Perhaps (I hope not), Mṛcch. 54, 24;
 d. by ननु Certainly, Rām. 4, 24, 37.
 5. With an imperative, No matter, Mṛcch. 75, 6.
 --Comp.
 when latter part of a comp. adj. the fem. ends -नाम्नी, Man. 3, 9; or -नामन्, Rām. 1, 6, 25; or -नामा, 2, 109, 47 Gorr.
 --Cf. Lat. nomen, co-gnomen, nam, quis-nam (cf. quem-nam = कं नाम), nem-pe (cf. नाम अपि); ὄνομα (for ὀ + γνομα), ὀνομαίνω (for ὀνομαν + ϳω); Goth. namo; A.S. nama, nemnan.

नाम(न्)- + मात्र नाम(न्)- + मात्र,
 I. n. nothing but the name, only the name, Pañc. iii. d. 78.
 II. adj. bearing only the name of something (not being it really), Pañc. i. d. 87; ii. d. 93.
नाम(न्)- + मुद्रा नाम(न्)- + मुद्रा, f. a seal-ring with the name of the possessor, Śāk. 17, 4.
नाम(न्)- + यज्ञ नाम(न्)- + यज्ञ, m. a nominal sacrifice only (not real), Bhag. 16, 7.
नम्र- + विटप नम्र- + विटप, adj. the branches of which are bent down, Vikr. d. 27.
नाम-शेष नाम-शेष, i. e. नामन्-, adj., f. षा, 1. one of whom only the name is left, Utt. Rāmac. 37, 18. 2. dead.
